correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=7, a multiset code collision induces a permutation of the selected triple. The edge-centre matching lemma identifies each matched distance with a rotation or reflection; exhaustive permutation-type analysis leaves precisely repeated clockwise gaps and the n=2 mod 4 antipodal obstruction, each of which has a constructive edge-code collision. The positive-composition inclusion-exclusion count and free dihedral action finish the formula. The independent BFS-based finite verifier enumerated all three-subsets and all edges for 3<=n<=28 with zero discrepancies; finite checking alone does not prove all n.

value.rationale: An all-order exact classification of optimal configurations for an existing edge-identification invariant is a naturally motivated strengthening of the published scalar minimum. A specific mod-four antipodal exception, a cubic labelled-count formula, and an exact dihedral orbit count give substantive structural information about all optimal placements without merely modifying a known example.
